campaigns.title: First HBOT visit: questions worth asking
campaigns.hook: Before your first HBOT visit, ask these three questions.
campaigns.intro: What should you ask about chamber options, appointment length and screening before scheduling a first hyperbaric oxygen session? Rescu's Scarsdale booking experience offers a starting point.

facts.text: Rescu lists hyperbaric oxygen among its wellness and recovery services.
Rescu describes an introductory First Dive offering; eligibility, price and availability need confirmation.

campaigns.title: TriLift demo: what to know first
campaigns.hook: Thinking about a facial muscle workout?
campaigns.intro: TriLift is an established offering at RESCU. Explore how dynamic muscle stimulation, RF and RF microneedling differ, and what questions to bring to a consultation.

facts.text: Rescu describes TriLift as combining facial muscle stimulation and radiofrequency technologies.
Rescu offers a $300 demonstration as described on its TriLift page, subject to current terms.

campaigns.title: Six-week Skin Plan: what is included?
campaigns.hook: A facial plan is more than a single appointment.
campaigns.intro: Rescu's coordinated Skin Plan includes TriLift-related treatments and complementary wellness visits. Ask about clinical spacing, candidacy and program terms before enrollment.

facts.text: The published Skin Plan lists six TriLift/DMSt visits and three RF microneedling treatments.
Six red light + PEMF appointments and six 40-minute HBOT visits are also listed, subject to individual screening.
Rescu says RF microneedling is minimally invasive and treatment spacing may extend beyond six weeks.

campaigns.title: What happens at a RESCU Reset?
campaigns.hook: New to RESCU? Explore your starting point.
campaigns.intro: The introductory RESCU Reset combines a goal-setting conversation with a short Red Light + PEMF experience and a personalized Roadmap. Ask about the current new-guest eligibility terms.

facts.text: The RESCU Reset page lists a wellness goal assessment, a 20-minute Red Light + PEMF visit and a personalized roadmap.
The Reset is promoted as complimentary for eligible new guests, subject to conditions and appointment availability.

campaigns.title: Pelvic-floor consultation: questions to ask
campaigns.hook: Pelvic floor concerns deserve a thoughtful conversation.
campaigns.intro: Emsella is one of the services listed at RESCU. Learn what a consultation covers and how the clinician helps assess suitability before booking treatment.

facts.text: Rescu includes Emsella in its pelvic-floor and body services listings.
Emsella appears among the services available to explore on Rescu's booking page.

campaigns.title: A wellness pilot your team can actually explore
campaigns.hook: What would a wellness visit look like for your team?
campaigns.intro: Westchester employers can explore a small team wellness conversation with RESCU before committing to any program. Share the number of interested employees and the practical scheduling needs.

facts.text: Rescu includes Corporate Wellness in its online Programs and Memberships booking categories.
Rescu offers multiple recovery and wellness services that may be discussed when considering a group experience.

campaigns.title: Emsculpt NEO: the first-visit conversation
campaigns.hook: Body contouring is not the same as weight loss.
campaigns.intro: Explore what Emsculpt NEO involves, which treatment goals it is intended for, and how Rescu approaches consultation and appropriate expectations.

facts.text: Rescu lists Emsculpt NEO under body and performance services.
Rescu's treatment directory distinguishes muscle and body contouring options from other recovery services.

campaigns.title: Questions before considering an ozone consultation
campaigns.hook: Ask about evidence, risks and screening first.
campaigns.intro: RESCU lists ozone consultation as a physician-led wellness offering. Understand the evidence limitations and questions to ask about risks and suitability before considering an appointment.

facts.text: Rescu's treatment directory says an ozone consultation begins with physician screening.
Rescu presents ozone in its treatment directory as a consultation rather than a guaranteed outcome.
